response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, long-tenured software craftsman with broad experience across web, mobile, embedded and backend systems, and meets the baseline years-of-experience and language requirements. However, the resume shows no evidence of experience in growth engineering, experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical/bias analysis — the core domain of this role. His career trajectory (Senior/Staff titles, mostly small companies/startups) also doesn't clearly demonstrate the Principal-level (IC6) scope of leading multi-team, cross-org initiatives that this position requires.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, hands-on engineering experience across many languages and platforms
Strong generalist with production, performance-critical, and infrastructure experience (e.g., low-latency DLang microservices at Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated mentoring, workshop-leading, and open-source project ownership showing technical leadership instincts
concerns: No direct experience with experimentation systems, A/B testing, feature flagging, or growth/measurement platforms
No evidence of statistical analysis, telemetry design, or rollout-risk/bias-detection work required for this role
Career leveling (Senior/Staff at small companies) doesn't clearly match the Principal/IC6 scope of driving multi-team initiatives at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: No demonstrated Principal-level cross-team technical leadership
Broad, long-tenured engineering background with relevant languages
